summary: Unum Group filed an 8-K reporting a Board-authorized ~10% increase in its quarterly common stock dividend, from prior to 50.5¢/share ($2.02 annualized), effective 3Q 2026. No price, premium, or advisor were disclosed. The dividend hike signals management confidence and a return-of-capital policy shift. Investors should watch for subsequent earnings coverage ratios and any buyback program updates as risk-arb considerations.
